versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the canvs skill.
- Enables creation and editing of collaborative whiteboards and diagrams using Canvs.io tools.
- Supports diagrams (flowcharts, wireframes, mind maps, etc.) and UI mockups based on user descriptions.
- Uses Mermaid syntax for connected diagrams; provides wireframe and illustration capabilities.
- Provides guidance on tool selection and workflow for seamless collaboration.
- Shares a unique canvas link for real-time collaboration.
